cases.name: defaultPngDecodeStreamsUnknownSizeBinaryAndPreservesEveryPixel
cases.accepted_boundary: Real native seeded257x193 ARGB8888 PNG encode, >64KiB binary payload and explicitly unknown-size row from a real separate-process same-UID private FileProvider. Public metadata must not open it; actual source-only KmpFileFetcher, non-main dispatch, one native REG FD and non-consuming16-byte peek are observed before the unmodified default BitmapFactoryDecoder. Partial encoded buffering is asserted; all49601 opaque/transparent output pixels, dimensions/config/DISK/unsampled result and unchanged backing bytes match. Reporter native FD0 is required before fixture deletion.
proven_scope: Native PNG decoder/encoded streaming and full decoded pixel parity
Success source closure and test-owned bitmap/file cleanup
limitations: No peak-memory benchmark; test reference bytes and native bitmap allocations exist
No cross-UID assertion for PNG; this provider is same UID in a different process
No metadata ImageDecoder or kernel-seek path

cases.name: defaultJpegDecodeReplaysBoundsAndExifForRotationAndReflection
cases.accepted_boundary: Real native96x64 four-quadrant JPEGs and Android ExifInterface orientation6(clockwise90) and7(transverse) are written/read. The same source-only default BitmapFactoryDecoder receives initial-position buffered content; actual64x96 ARGB8888 output must match independent geometry and interior RGB values within12. Both fresh requests require one open, real native REG FD through fetch/decode, default decoder identity, source byte immutability and reporter FD0. Null metadata/no staged file is asserted.
proven_scope: Default buffered bounds/EXIF-compatible decoding for rotation and reflection
Success source/bitmap closure in each of two native requests
limitations: JPEG is lossy: only specified interior RGB tolerance, not whole decoded-pixel equality
Default route is observed; individual internal inJustDecodeBounds/lseek calls are not independently logged
No kernel seek or metadata ImageDecoder route
No other EXIF orientations, device/vendor/target or cache policy certification

cases.name: repeatedDefaultCorruptDecodesReleaseActualCrossUidDescriptors
cases.accepted_boundary: Existing separate-UID DocumentsProvider grants one fixed read-only tree through genuine foreground Activity-result READ/PERSISTABLE/PREFIX flags, ClipData and public bookmark creation. Native service/reply signatures, UIDs, nonce, PID/process/generation and denied MANAGE_DOCUMENTS/ungranted preconditions are checked. Four sequential unmodified default BitmapFactoryDecoder corrupt-image failures produce the exact null-bitmap IllegalStateException, one fetch/start/error and no success/decodeEnd each. Actual cross-UID REG stat/fdinfo identity and reporter FD1 precede decoding; remote opens/closes grow1..4 with zero writes/closeErrors, and reporter FD0 follows every failure. Finally releases bookmark, checks quiescent counts before reset and joins owned endpoint thread.
proven_scope: Unmodified default-decoder failure releases actual transferred source on four sequential rounds
Actual fixed URI grant and deterministic endpoint/bookmark cleanup
limitations: Corrupt bytes are prefix/length/calibration checked, not newly read in full for binary parity
No default-decoder cancellation or concurrent requests
No native peak heap/resource stress benchmark beyond four bounded rounds
Grant/release prerequisite does not newly execute restart or revoked public reads

production_stream_route.review: Real ContentResolver InputStream to kotlinx-io/Okio buffered source-only ImageSource; native DISK classification; construction-failure close; ownership transferred to Coil. No new production patch by this reviewer.

default_registry_witness.review: Only the production KmpFileFetcher factory is added; no decoder factory is injected. Observational event listener requires BitmapFactoryDecoder at decodeStart/End, one actual transferred REG FD, no metadata/staged file and exact event outcomes.16-byte peek is non-consuming and not a replacement source.

same_uid_native_source.review: Private real registered AndroidX FileProvider owns constrained cache files, delegates normal native open, deliberately changes only unknown-size metadata, checks reporter UID/provider process declaration and provider PID differs. PNG/JPEG do not claim separate UID.

native_descriptor_calibration.review: Actual REG stat device/inode agrees with strict kernel fdinfo inode; reporter enumerates original descriptors before probe duplication, counts exact inode+device, tolerates only proven EBADF races and closes every duplicate. Cross-UID provider callback publishes closes after closeErrors. Positive FD1 then FD0 is asserted; no heap/global leak guarantee.

actual_native_grant_and_identity.review: Actual foreground Activity result creates read-only grant; reporter lacks MANAGE_DOCUMENTS and URI access beforehand, correct flags/ClipData/native permission and persisted read-only grant are checked. Control is signature-only and authentic Messenger nonce/UID/process/generation bound; no manual grant. Raw numeric native identity values are not independently exported.

failure_safe_native_cleanup.review: Sequential loader shutdown; test-owned bitmap recycle; descriptor-zero check before exclusive owned-directory deletion; bookmark release; all fixed source counts/errors/writes quiescent before reset; endpoint unbind and quitSafely/join pending-empty. Primary failure preserved and cleanup failures cannot turn a method green. Normal paths execute; not every failure-path runtime calibration.

helper_host_identity_and_ownership.review: Actual source/installed APK hash, compiled manifest and modern single-signer/private certificate readback, API35-only integer range, fixed live AVD lease and exact hash recheck before force-stop/uninstall/absence. Controller receives actual native result and cleanup remains required. No downloaded APK/key or package validation beyond receipt/source scope.

fresh_original_results.review: Fresh task outputs cannot use cache/up-to-date, effective class/serial and AGP output are verified, collector requires one marker, bounded regular unchanged XML mtime in invocation +/-2s, no duplicate/foreign/skip and exact three methods. Original stat is not exported; naive XML/ZIP timestamp alone is not independent freshness/timezone evidence.
